column1: # Human-reviewed class decisions for docs/state-map/entrypoints.tsv, read and
# applied by cmd/statemapgen ON TOP OF Classify's freshly computed class for
# any matching (kind,id) row -- so a triage decision survives regeneration.
# See internal/statemap/overrides.go's package doc for the full rationale
# (a coordinator review on SESSION-AT's AT0 PR caught the FIRST version of
# this generator silently overwriting human classifications on every run).
# Empty so far -- SESSION-AT's own time budget went to building the
# mechanism (this file + the REVIEW ratchet in completeness_test.go) rather
# than hand-triaging the ~178 rows Classify currently flags REVIEW. That
# triage is real follow-up work; see the SESSION-AT report's hand-back
# section. Add a row here, lower internal/statemap/completeness_test.go's
# maxReviewRows by one, and re-run `go run ./cmd/statemapgen` for each row
# risk/rotation/secret-access rows): 37 of 38 rows in this slice read out as
# class D or C -- single-write CLI wrappers around one REST call, or local
# artifact writes with loud partial-failure handling. `keyorix backup` is
# intentionally left at REVIEW -- it is server/admin/backup.go, in scope for
# Session AT's backup/restore triage, not this batch.
